observed.facings.png: Three facings at one scale: each shows a thick, flat, roughly rectangular slab of red-and-pink marbled flesh. Its top and sides are crossed by dark red seams and carry patches of black-brown charred crust. It stands on four identical thick, fleshy, twisted legs ending in dark split hooves. South and north look almost the same: a wide slab with four legs placed like the legs of a table, and no head, mouth or eyes on either. East is a little longer, has the same four legs and a ragged right end, and also has no head. The whole thing reads like a footstool or ottoman made of raw meat.
observed.south.png: A wide flat slab of marbled raw-looking flesh with charred crust plates around its rim and top, on four symmetric hooved legs, two in front and two behind. There is no head, face, mouth or eye, so nothing marks this side as the front. Clean alpha.
observed.east.png: The same slab from the side, a little longer than it is deep, on four legs. The right end is ragged with charred flaps; the left end is a flat cut face. There is no head, neck or mouth at either end, so there is no profile to read. Clean alpha.
observed.north.png: Almost a copy of south: the same wide slab, the same arrangement of crust plates, the same four symmetric legs. No face, which is correct for a rear, but there is also no tail or haunch, so nothing tells rear from front. Clean alpha.
observed.scale.png: At max zoom the creature is about 1.1 cells wide and comes up to about the human's waist: a low meat table on four legs. At 32 px per cell it reads as a small pink-red rectangle on legs, visible against the ground but not readable as an animal.

SOUTH_FRONT.seen: South shows the wide side of the slab on four legs with no head, face or mouth. It cannot be told apart from north, so it does not read as the front facing the camera.

NORTH_REAR.seen: North has no face or eyes. It is the same slab as south, with no tail or haunch to mark it as the rear, but it breaks no rule.

NO_OVERHEAD.seen: All three facings use the angled game camera: top surface and side visible, legs below. None is top-down.

SAME_SIZE.seen: Code measured a 6% height spread, and the panel agrees.

SAME_ANIMAL.seen: Same palette, crust plates and four hooved legs on every facing. East is longer, as a side view should be.

SIGNATURE.seen: A low armoured slab on legs with seared crust plates: the literal description is visible.

ALIEN.seen: No stranger would name it a tortoise. It reads as alien, or as a piece of furniture, not as an Earth animal.

DEPARTURES.seen: 1 present: the body is a flat rectangular slab, not a dome. 2 present: the charred plates are irregular and misaligned, not banded. 3 partly present: the seams and charred bark read as seared, but the pink marbling reads more like a raw steak than puckered keloid scar. 4 present: the slab sits as a separate mass on top of the legs, and there is no head or limbs sticking out of a shell.

STYLE.seen: Painterly and realistic in texture, not cute or cel-shaded. The overall silhouette is very regular, like furniture.

OURS.seen: This is not a vanilla or other-mod animal. It is original generated art.

ALPHA.seen: Clean cut-out on all three facings, with no ground patch or shadow.

SCALE.seen: About one cell wide and up to the human's waist. That fits 'low' and a drawSize of 1.15.

LEGIBLE.seen: At 32 px it shows as a red-pink rectangle on legs, distinct from the ground. It is readable as a shape, though not as an animal.

reply.needs_call_why: The literal description, a slab of scar tissue on legs, is drawn faithfully, and the def never mentions a head. A second reviewer should judge whether the owner reads a headless meat table with identical south and north as a front-less creature or furniture (redo) or accepts it as intentionally faceless.
proposals: Invented headless body plans need a rule of their own: some front-marking feature (mouth, sensory pit, leading edge) on south, so south and north differ for creatures with no head.

reply.subject: RM_Scaldhide
reply.image_seen: The shared-scale panel and individual south, east and north sprites show a broad, flat pink-red slab with dark crusted plates on four sinewy legs; the scale panel shows it low beside a human and very small at normal zoom.

concerns.evidence: South shows two prominent legs facing the camera with two smaller legs recessed behind them, supporting a frontal reading; east shows the legs staggered along the body and an asymmetric projecting right end. Missing facial features alone does not establish an incorrect facing for this slab-bodied creature.

All three facings have a nearly level, rectangular upper mass resting on four similarly shaped upright supports. South and north especially resemble a meat-covered footstool: the legs meet the underside like furniture legs, with little visible shoulder or haunch anatomy.

The plate patterns differ visibly. South has a broad horizontal dark plate near the upper centre and a large diagonal dark patch on its right; north has a pointed central dark plate and rounded pink lobes near its right edge. The inner legs also differ in position and contour. These are distinct pictures with a similar body plan.

The upper mass is dominated by pale pink lobes separated by deep red seams, resembling fat and exposed meat. Dark seared patches are present, but the broad pink surfaces lack the raised, contracted ridges that would make scar tissue the dominant reading; the legs look like exposed muscle fibres.

findings.seen: A level rectangular slab rests on four similarly shaped, regularly arranged supports, producing a footstool silhouette.
findings.quote: a natural thing that looks man-made
findings.fix: The slab has an organically uneven perimeter and four weight-bearing legs with distinct joints, haunches and irregular fleshy attachments beneath it.

findings.where: south.png, east.png and north.png; upper body surface
findings.seen: Smooth pale lobes and red dividing seams dominate the body, reading as butchered meat despite scattered dark burnt patches.
findings.quote: Surface reads as scar tissue (puckered, seared, keloid-like), not scaly or leathery animal hide
findings.fix: The slab surface consists of contracted burn scars, raised irregular keloid ridges and puckered fused tissue surrounding embedded charred armour plates.
